name: Gahz'ridian
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
adventurer, I'm a scientist, but also a treasure hunter at heart!

Long ago, when trolls used to occupy this land, they created large amounts of ornaments modeled after Gahz'rilla, a hydra they worshipped as a deity. These ornaments are carved out of an element that I call "Gahz'ridian", after the hydra god.

I did find some myself, but I'd like to have some more to study -- maybe you can find some?

I even invented a detector that makes finding the Gahz'ridian a snap! Just put it on, and the search begins!
narrative.objectives: Marvon Rivetseeker in Tanaris wants you to collect 30 Gahz'ridian Ornaments.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Perfect; these ornaments are perfect for my studies. Thanks so much for the help, adventurer.

Oh, can I get my helmet back?
narrative.requestItemsText:
Are you having any trouble?

You can find Gahz'ridian just about anywhere in Tanaris, adventurer, so keep looking!
